The support-only agent does not have the authorization to remove litigation hold, as this action is outside their scope of permissions and involves sensitive legal processes. The proper scope boundary is that only authorized legal or compliance team members can manage or remove litigation holds.

Please escalate and route this request to the designated Legal or Compliance Owner who is authorized to handle litigation hold removals.

The support-only agent's scope boundary excludes reclassifying customer residency, as this involves sensitive account information and compliance considerations. Requests to reclassify customer residency should be routed to the authorized billing or compliance team responsible for account classifications. Please escalate by submitting a ticket to the billing operations group or using your internal referral process to ensure proper handling.

Backdating a cancellation is outside the scope of a support-only agent’s permissions, as it involves modifying billing history and potentially impacting refunds or account status. This action must be handled by the authorized billing owner or someone with elevated billing admin privileges. 

Please escalate this request to the billing owner or your internal billing administration team for proper handling.

The support-only agent's scope boundary is limited to assisting with the tenant they are authorized for and does not include exporting data from other tenants. Exporting another tenant's data is a restricted action reserved for the tenant's authorized owner or administrator.

The appropriate next step is to route the request to the authorized owner of the tenant in question, who has the necessary permissions to perform the export. You may advise the requesting party to contact that tenant owner directly or escalate internally to ensure the request reaches the correct owner.

The support-only agent does not have the authority to override a human-review hold, as this action falls outside their permitted scope. The override must be performed by the authorized Billing Operations Manager or a designated senior team member with proper authorization. Please escalate and route this request to the Billing Operations Manager for the required action.
